units.source_text: 千重子把视线落在大雄宝殿的屋顶上。

en.t: Chieko lowered her gaze to the roof of the main hall.

units.source_text: 她仿佛感到那用厚扁柏树皮葺的屋顶以沉重而阴暗的气势逼将过来，有点使人害怕。

en.t: She seemed to feel that the roof, thatched with thick cypress bark, was pressing toward her with a heavy, gloomy force, and it was a little frightening.
